title: Z-Image Turbo
description: Text to image. Fast: 8 steps, a few seconds per image.

labels.57:27:text: Describe the image: subject, setting, light and style.

hints: Write the prompt as a full description: who or what, where, the light, the camera and the style.
This model has no negative prompt. Say what you want to see, not what to avoid.
Text in the picture works best when the exact words are put in quotes.
Steps and CFG are fixed at 8 and 1, the values this turbo model is made for.
